# Clip Studio Paint

> Official website for Clip Studio Paint, the professional digital art software for illustration, comics, manga, webtoons, animation, and concept art.

Clip Studio Paint is developed by CELSYS and available across Windows, macOS, iPad, iPhone, and Android platforms. The software comes in three editions (DEBUT, PRO, and EX) with specialized tools for digital artists, manga creators, animators, and concept artists, supported by a global community and asset marketplace (CLIP STUDIO ASSETS).

## Key Topics

- Clip Studio Paint PRO
- Clip Studio Paint EX
- Digital illustration
- Comics and manga creation
- Webtoon production
- 2D animation
- Concept art
- Digital painting
- CLIP STUDIO ASSETS
- CLIP STUDIO TABMATE
- Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, iPad, Android, iPhone)
- Volume licensing for education and enterprise
- Digital coloring contests
- Illustration contests

## Core Features & Use Cases

- [Comics, Manga & Webtoons - Clip Studio Paint](https://www.clipstudio.net/en/comics-manga): Comics, manga & webtoons creation software for professionals
- [Clip Studio Paint – Aplicación de arte digital para ilustración, cómic y animación](https://www.clipstudio.net/es/functions/drawing): Digital art app for illustration, comics & animation (Spanish)
- [Clip Studio Paint – Aplicación de arte digital para ilustración, cómic y animación](https://www.clipstudio.net/es/functions/animation): Animation features for Clip Studio Paint PRO and EX (Spanish)
- [CLIP STUDIO PAINT – 數位繪圖・漫畫・動畫的製作應用程式](https://www.clipstudio.net/tc/functions/community): Community features for digital painting & manga creation (Traditional Chinese)
- [Guide d'introduction au concept art - CLIP STUDIO PAINT](https://www.clipstudio.net/fr/conceptart/beginners-guide): Concept art beginner's guide covering character design & environments (French)
